verdict: P0 BLOCKER for V1 production = refund UI button absent (backend NF525-ready, sentinel-tested, just no cashier-facing trigger). P1 daily-pain = no parked-order transfer between cashiers + no session-pause / lock-screen. P2 nice-to-have = customer history panel + internal order note + cancel-arbitrary-line + switch-cashier + quick-hold pattern. Total 5 owner-implicit gaps verified, 4 additional bonus gaps surfaced. Recommendation: ship G-S2P3-01 (refund UI) as V1 P0 before NF525 production cutover. Bonus G-S2P3-06 (pos_payment_note dual-use as refund-reason overwriting card stub) is a hidden NF525 6-year-traceability hazard worth elevating to P1 audit and decoupling refund_reason into its own column.
